results.title: Head of Operations

Develop and implement operational strategies aligned with business objectives. Drive operational performance, productivity, and continuous improvement initiatives. Monitor KPIs and implement action plans to achieve business targets. Lead, coach, and develop regional management teams. Ensure consistent execution of operational standards across all locations. results.title: Head of Operations & Project Management
results.company: Oh Yes Events Private Limited, Chennai, India & Dubai,UAE
results.description: Company Description Oh Yes Events Private Limited is a full-service event management company recognized for creatively designing and executing events that align closely with each client’s vision. The team meticulously plans both the micro and macro aspects of wedding and special events, acting as a one-stop partner for all event-related requirements. With expertise in building unique themes and recreating customized experiences, the company focuses on delivering high levels of client satisfaction for every project. Oh Yes Events operates with a strong sense of passion, attention to detail, and a client-centric approach, powered by positivity, agile leadership, and a commitment to going beyond expectations in Chennai, India and Dubai, UAE. Role Description The Head of Operations & Project Management is a full-time, on-site role based in Dubai, responsible for overseeing end-to-end planning and execution of events. This role leads cross-functional teams to ensure smooth operations, from initial client briefing and concept development to vendor coordination, logistics, on-ground management, and post-event review. The position involves designing and implementing operational processes, resource planning, budgeting, and risk management to deliver high-quality, immersive event experiences. The Head of Operations & Project Management will maintain strong client relationships, translate client requirements into actionable project plans, and drive continuous improvement across locations, aligning teams with the company’s values and performance standards. Qualifications Candidates should possess strong operations and project management skills, including resource planning, workflow optimization, risk management, and end-to-end project delivery. Candidates should possess expertise in event management and production, including vendor coordination, logistics planning, on-site execution, and quality assurance for large-scale events. Candidates should possess leadership and people management skills, including team building, performance management, cross-functional collaboration, and the ability to drive change. Candidates should possess client-facing skills, including stakeholder management, negotiation, solution-focused communication, and the ability to translate client needs into executable plans. Candidates should possess analytical and organizational skills, including budgeting, timeline management, data-driven decision-making, and attention to detail. Experience in the events industry, hospitality, or related domains, preferably in international or multicultural environments. Bachelor’s degree in business, event management, operations, or a related field; advanced certifications in project management (e.g., PMP, PRINCE2) are an advantage. Ability to work flexible hours, including evenings and weekends, based on event schedules; proficiency in relevant project management and collaboration tools. Location: Dubai, UAE (Requires travel across the Emirates for site visits and event execution). Employment Type: Full-time. Reporting To: CEO / Board of Directors.

results.title: Director of Operations
results.description: About the Role: We are seeking an experienced and dynamic Director of Operations to oversee the day-to-day operations of a luxury 5-star hotel, ensuring exceptional service standards, operational excellence, and a consistently outstanding guest experience. The ideal candidate will have a strong Food & Beverage and Culinary background, with proven experience leading complex F&B operations, while also demonstrating a solid understanding of Rooms Division and other key hotel departments. Key Responsibilities: Oversee the daily operations of the hotel, ensuring seamless coordination across all operational departments. Provide strategic and operational leadership to F&B, Culinary, Rooms, and other guest-facing departments. Take a strong leadership role in Food & Beverage and Culinary operations, ensuring exceptional quality, service standards, profitability, and guest satisfaction. Drive operational excellence across restaurants, bars, banqueting, room service, and culinary operations. Ensure all departments consistently deliver the standards expected of a luxury 5-star property. Monitor operational performance, revenue, profitability, quality, and guest satisfaction across the hotel. Develop and implement operational strategies and initiatives in line with the hotel's business objectives. Collaborate with the senior management on budgeting, forecasting, business planning, and performance improvement. Maintain strong knowledge and oversight of Front Office, Housekeeping, Engineering, Spa, Security, and other hotel operations, ensuring effective cross-departmental coordination. Monitor guest feedback and service recovery initiatives, ensuring concerns are addressed promptly and professionally. Lead, coach, and develop department heads and operational teams, fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement. Ensure compliance with hotel policies, brand standards, health and safety regulations, HACCP, and other applicable requirements. Identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency, service quality, revenue generation, and guest experiences. Support the planning and execution of VIP arrivals, special events, functions, and high-profile hotel activities. Maintain strong relationships with key guests, owners, stakeholders, and business partners. Support the successful planning, development, and execution of pre-opening projects across the company’s hospitality portfolio, ensuring alignment with brand standards, operational objectives, and project timelines. Requirements: Minimum 8–10 years of progressive hotel operations experience, preferably within luxury 5-star hotels. Strong background in Food & Beverage and Culinary operations, with substantial experience overseeing restaurants, bars, banqueting, and/or large-scale culinary operations. Previous experience at Director of Operations, Director of F&B, Executive Assistant Manager, or a similar senior leadership level. Comprehensive understanding of overall hotel operations, including Rooms Division and other key departments. Strong commercial acumen with proven experience in budgeting, forecasting, cost control, and driving profitability. Proven experience in leading pre-opening projects within luxury or upscale hospitality environments. Excellent leadership, communication, and people-management skills. Strong understanding of luxury service standards and guest experience. Proven ability to lead large, multicultural teams and work effectively in a fast-paced luxury hospitality environment. Excellent problem-solving, decision-making, and organizational skills. Bachelor's degree or relevant hospitality qualification is preferred. International luxury hotel experience is highly desirable.

results.title: Regional Operations Manager

results.title: General Manager
results.description: Summary The General Manager (GM), in conjunction with the management team will strategically lead all areas within the hotel. The GM is responsible for optimizing profitability, the guest experience and overall hotel quality performance, team member engagement, market share and ultimately return on owner investment. The objectives of this role will be to lead the hotel opening project according to the Critical path and to ensure the right team is recruited, onboarded, and trained at the right time according to the opening date and business forecast. Furthermore, the incumbent will achieve revenue optimization, effective cost-control, and implementation of quality operational standards within the framework of the brand. The GM will lead and develop a hotel team of hospitality professionals to deliver exceptional guest service and quality as well as the operational and financial objectives within the operating budget and business plan. Key Responsibilities Leadership: The GM will work with the hotel Management Team to ensure the successful delivery of the individual departmental plans as they fit within the overall hotels business strategy. The GM will inspire, coach, guide and motivate their team and act as the leader for the property with respect to relationship management and development. He/she will lead by example, to inspire the team to ‘Do the Right Thing’. The GM is ultimately accountable for the achievement of all hotel KPI’s. Ensure the hotel meets and exceeds the Wyndham People Compliance Standards Level 1 – CORE. Strategy & Planning The GM will define and execute a detailed strategic budget plan for the hotel. This will also include setting performance targets, comply with all company standards and defining the objectives for the hotel subject to owner approval. The GM will focus to develop the awareness of the hotel within the city, region and country, to help the ‘Grow our Iconic Brands’, supported by PR, Social Media plans, relationship with Media, and attendance at key exhibitions. He/she will build an excellent relationship with owners, protecting the assets and acting as a Brand Ambassador. Business Performance The GM will be accountable for the overall success and performance of the hotel including: Achieving targeted Revenue, and GOP. Delivery of commercial plan and achieving sales targets. Continuous evolve RevPAR and RGI. Achieving target quality scores (Medallia & Quality Audit). Delivery of HR plan and achieving People targets i.e., Employee engagement, turnover, productivity ratios, time to hire etc. Achieve targeted Wyndham Rewards enrollments. Achieving and evolving the Wyndham Green certification. Ensuring profitability by keeping a firm control over the bottom line, anticipating and or resolving potential problems, obstacles which may hinder revenue optimization, cost control or quality. Quality As the guardian and protector of the brand, the GM will ensure brand standard compliance. In conjunction with the Heads of Department, he/she will roll out Operating Standards (SOP’s) and relevant employee training to drive service excellence and high guest service performance. Human Resources The GM will ensure in conjunction with the hotel management team and Hotel HR Leader to identify, select, recruit, develop, engage, manage, retain and inspire team members to maximise the hotels return on Human Capital. The GM will role model the service culture values. Hotel Opening The GM will ensure that all tasks are actioned in time according to the Critical Path The GM will conduct any other reasonable duties assigned by owners. It is not the intent of this Job Description to cover all aspects of the position but to highlight the most important areas of responsibility. KEY COMPETENCIES Alongside with the fundamentals of the brand service culture, the incumbent will be required to demonstrate the below competencies: Business Acumen Building Trust Communication Integrity Driving Results Innovation Leadership effectiveness Valuing diversity BACKGROUND BA in Business or Hotel Management 2-3 years’ experience as a General Manager from an international hotel brand Fluency in local language and professional level of English , Arabic is a plus. A strong sense of commerciality and financial acumen Computer literacy and a high level of competency within Microsoft Office programmes and hotel reservations systems (Micros Opera) Knowledge of the GCC Market will be a plus.

results.title: Restaurant General Manager

Ensure full compliance with resort operating controls, SOPs, policies, procedures, and service standards. Lead all key property matters including capital projects, customer service, and refurbishment. Handle complaints and oversee the service recovery procedures. results.title: General Manager – Six Senses Zighy Bay, Oman
results.location: Dibba Al Bayah, Musandam Governorate, Oman
results.description: Description As General Manager, I will fully comprehend the vision of Six Senses to help people reconnect with themselves, others, and the world around them, and our values of local sensitivity and global sensibility, crafted experiences, emotional hospitality, responsible and caring, fun and quirky, and pioneering wellness. Sustainability, wellness, and out of the ordinary experiences are at the core of everything we do at Six Senses. I will safeguard these pillars through strategic planning and execution, ensuring all initiatives are fully embedded across the resort. As the leader of Six Senses Zighy Bay, I will drive the positioning of the resort as a leading ultra-luxury destination in the Middle East, delivering highly personalized guest experiences within a complex and remote operating environment, while maintaining the highest brand standards and owner expectations. Duties And Responsibilities As General Manager, I will assume full responsibility for the efficient operation of the resort to provide exceptional products and services in line with Six Senses brand standards and financial objectives. The duties and responsibilities will include: ▪ Lead the overall operation and positioning of Six Senses Zighy Bay as a benchmark ultra-luxury resort in the Middle East. ▪ Drive a highly personalized villa-based guest experience, ensuring exceptional service delivery aligned with elevated guest expectations and brand standards. ▪ Foster an inclusive, engaged, and high-performing culture, with a strong focus on attracting, developing, and retaining talent in a remote location environment. ▪ Ensure full alignment with Six Senses operational standards across all departments, maintaining and exceeding performance benchmarks. ▪ Instill a strong commercial mindset across the team, driving revenue through high ADR strategies, premium experiences, and wellness offerings, while maintaining cost discipline and operational efficiencies. ▪ Oversee the strategic direction of sales, marketing, and PR to strengthen brand positioning across key GCC and international markets. ▪ Manage operational complexity across villas, dining concepts, wellness, and logistics, ensuring seamless delivery of guest experiences. ▪ Champion sustainability and regenerative practices, including Earth Lab initiatives, local sourcing, and on-site production, embedding these into daily operations and guest engagement. ▪ Ensure compliance with all legal, financial, health and safety, and regulatory requirements, including regional considerations and visa limitations impacting the workforce. ▪ Build and maintain strong relationships with ownership and key stakeholders, aligning on performance, operational priorities, and long-term strategic direction. ▪ Respect and uphold Omani traditions and Islamic culture, ensuring cultural sensitivity is embedded in both guest and host experiences. Qualifications To execute the position of General Manager, I must have the required qualifications, technical skills, and experience in a similar role within ultra-luxury resort environments, including: ▪ Proven experience as a General Manager in an ultra-luxury resort, ideally within remote or complex environments. ▪ Strong background in villa product operations with a high level of personalization and guest engagement. ▪ Demonstrated experience in sustainability-driven operations, with a clear understanding of regenerative practices. ▪ Strong commercial acumen, with the ability to drive revenue through premium positioning, guest experiences, and wellness offerings. ▪ Experience operating within highly competitive luxury markets, ideally within the Middle East region. ▪ Ability to manage complex logistics in remote environments, including supply chain, workforce, and operational challenges. ▪ Outstanding leadership capabilities, with a track record of building, inspiring, and retaining diverse teams in remote locations. ▪ Strong alignment with Six Senses and IHG luxury lifestyle philosophy and values. ▪ High level of guest engagement capability, with a focus on delivering exceptional and memorable experiences for high-net-worth clientele. ▪ Understanding of GCC guest profiles alongside international luxury travellers. ▪ Strong cultural awareness, with the ability to operate effectively within Omani traditions and regional sensitivities. ▪ Fluency in English is required; Arabic is preferred. ▪ Regional experience in the Middle East and familiarity with remote resort environments is highly advantageous. ▪ Bachelor’s degree in Hospitality Management, Business Administration, or related field preferred. The above is intended to provide an overview of the role and responsibilities for a General Manager at Six Senses Zighy Bay, Oman. It is not intended to be an exhaustive list of all duties and responsibilities inherent to the position. Six Senses Zighy Bay is an equal opportunity employer. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment. Don't quite meet every single requirement, but still believe you'd be a great fit for the job? We'll never know unless you hit the 'Apply' button. Start your journey with us today.
